name: Copper
description: A middle-aged man with a clear high baritone, a light Turkish accent in fluent English, forward resonance, rounded vowels, and brisk conversational pacing. Expressive, sociable, and capable of gentle seriousness. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
purpose: A clear, animated baritone to contrast with the grainy and quiet men. Try a host, a farmer, and a worried parent.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
